opening: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?

lines.text: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.when: The customer asks whether the caller is a robot or an AI.

lines.text: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.when: Someone says the customer has died.

lines.text: Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.when: The identity check ends after three wrong answers in total.
The customer first declines a security question or asks what the call is about instead of answering.

lines.text: You can change your recorded promise in the mobile app.
lines.when: The customer asks to change or cancel a promise already recorded during this call.

lines.text: I could not record your promise.
lines.when: The second attempt to record the promise fails.

lines.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.when: A payment promise is successfully recorded.

lines.text: Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.when: The customer says they have already paid the past-due amount.

lines.text: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.when: The customer asks whether this call is a scam.

lines.text: I do not have that information.
lines.when: The customer asks a question that cannot be answered from the tools.
